title: alchemilla geranioides var. pentagona
intro: Alchemilla geranioides var. pentagona, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial plant species in the family Rosaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating menstrual disorders, digestive issues, and inflammation, due to its ability to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla geranioides var. pentagona include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce bleeding, alleviate pain, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
